description: The whole site as it looks once an editor publishes a chapter that the hand-written menu never knew about. Miami appears in the header dropdown, in the crimson strip along the top, and in the Our Chapters row — all from one markdown file, with nobody touching nav.json. Before this change the same publish produced a working chapter page and a new card here, but no menu entry and no warning that one was missing.
